entries.question: May the plugin infer permanent model capability from provider/model identity?
entries.decision: No unscoped inference. Provider plugin owns protocol adaptation; future discovery needs explicit source/lifetime/scope authority.

entries.question: May dynamic provider feedback be stored as permanent capability truth?
entries.decision: No. Current dynamic feedback is evidence with a scope and lifetime; missing feedback is not false and stale feedback must not defeat current feedback.

entries.question: How can users edit per-model Volcengine video transport when the shared generic model-card component lacks a reliable current-Provider identity boundary?
entries.decision: Do not show plugin video fields in generic model cards. On each owned Provider Source, persist volcengine_video_controls_visible as presentation-only state and project a temporary exact-current-Source model-card selector. When visible and saved, write choices to each card's canonical volcengine_video_input_enabled and strip the selector; hiding it preserves selections and runtime state. Snapshot the complete model-card list before translation. If host upsert raises, restore the in-memory snapshot and use available host save_config for a compensating persistent rollback because AstrBot may already have saved before Provider reload fails. Re-raise the original host error; if rollback persistence also fails, add that failure as a note and do not claim disk restoration. Foreign Sources receive neither field, and AstrBot modalities remain unchanged.

entries.question: What does migration preserve?
entries.decision: Preserve user configuration intent, not a model capability fact. Precedence is canonical per-card bool > exact-provider_source_id retired 0.1.17 UI bool > older per-card bool > legacy Source bool including false > modalities clue. Wrong-Source and foreign fields never promote; remove all temporary/wrong-layer debris and leave modalities unchanged.

entries.question: Does successful or failed interaction grant authority to make a global capability verdict?
entries.decision: No. Interaction is lower-level evidence; judgment requires sufficient conditions, scope, and decision authority.

entries.question: Must every release repeat the full QQ audio/video E2E?
entries.decision: No. Historical product-path evidence remains evidence until a relevant dependency edge changes; full QQ-equivalent revalidation is impact-triggered.
